Water Allocation Challenge. Survive 20 days. Five players bid daily for water via sealed, simultaneous bids. Every player starts with 8 HP (maximum 10) and $0. A win restores 2 HP up to 10 and resets consecutive days without water to zero. A loss removes k HP on the kth consecutive unsuccessful day; HP <= 0 eliminates a player. All players see everyone's bids and post-auction status after each day. Water is randomly provided each day at 10..19 inclusive units. Players: Alex needs 8 water/day, earns $70/day, Bob needs 9 water/day, earns $75/day, Cindy needs 10 water/day, earns $100/day, David needs 11 water/day, earns $120/day, Eric needs 12 water/day, earns $120/day.
